The '''Revenant Caves''', also known as the '''Forinthry Dungeon''', are a set of caverns found in the [[Wilderness]]. Accessible to [[members]] only, it is an extremely dangerous cave that ranges from level 17 to 40 Wilderness and is exclusively a [[singles-plus combat]] area.

The caves serve as a refuge for [[revenants]]. There are three one-way entrances:
* [[Cavern (Revenant Caves)#Level 17|Level 17 Wilderness]] — east of the [[Dark Warriors' Fortress]].
* [[Crevice (Revenant Caves)|Level 26 Wilderness]] — north of the [[Bandit Camp (Wilderness)|Bandit Camp]].
* [[Cavern (Revenant Caves)#Level 40|Level 40 Wilderness]] — south-east of the [[Lava Maze]].

In addition to the entrances, there is also an [[stairs (Revenant Caves)|exit]] by the level 17 and level 40 locations that allows players to leave the dungeon. These are intentionally placed away from the dungeon entrance to prevent players from escaping player killers by going in and out of them. In addition, there is a delay of 2 [[RuneScape clock|ticks]] (1.2 seconds) upon selecting any method of teleportation before it is activated, provided the player is in combat with an NPC while the attempt to teleport is made. This delay can be interrupted by another incoming attack from an NPC, resulting in the teleport delay timer having to be run down anew. The teleport delay is removed if the player has completed the [[hard Wilderness Diary]].

Unlike other locations in the Wilderness, [[death|dying]] to a revenant in the caves without taking damage from another player will be considered a '''player-versus-player''' death and follows its death mechanics accordingly. Any items not converted into coins or an untradeable/broken variant '''will be seen by every player for up to 60 minutes.'''

Players wearing an [[amulet of avarice]] gain a 20% bonus to damage and accuracy while fighting revenants in the cave, and will find that all their drops come in noted form, at the cost of being permanently [[Skull (status)|skulled]] while it is equipped.

A [[dwarf multicannon]] cannot be placed in the caves.

[[File:Revenant Caves location.png|thumb|left|200px|Revenant Caves entrance locations]]
'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' The entire area counts as the Wilderness. Players will be able to attack you here. So, only bring items you can afford to lose!

==Transportation==
To get to the caves, players will have to traverse the [[Wilderness]]. Aside from simply walking there, there are some other options:
*[[Revenant cave teleport]], which teleports the player to the level 40 entrance.
*[[Burning amulet]], can take players to two entrances:
**[[Bandit Camp (Wilderness)|Bandit Camp]] option - head east for the level 17 entrance.
**[[Lava Maze]] option - head east for the level 40 entrance.
*[[Wilderness Obelisk]]s can take players to two entrances:
**Level 27 obelisk - head east to the level 26 entrance.
**Level 35 obelisk - head north-east to the level 40 entrance.
*[[Carrallanger Teleport]], or the [[Carrallanger teleport|equivalent teleport tablet]], takes players to the [[Graveyard of Shadows]], close to the level 17 entrance.
*[[Canoeing]] to the Wilderness will take players close to the level 40 entrance.

==Features==
Before entering the caves, players must pay a fee of 100,000 coins. The fee can be taken from the bank and does not need to be brought along in the inventory. As long as the player does not die inside the cave or get killed by another player, the fee does not need to be repaid. Upon dying to anything inside the caves ('''including''' monsters) or to another player '''anywhere in the Wilderness''', the fee will be lost and '''must be repaid before re-entering the caves'''. If the killer was another player, the 100,000 coins will be dropped as loot.

The caves are very large but only contain [[revenants]], who are sparsely scattered throughout the caves.

There are five [[shortcuts]] around the dungeon, requiring various [[Agility]] levels to use. Boosts may be used to meet the requirement.

*The [[Pillar (Revenant Caves)#Easy|shortcut]] between the revenant goblin and the southern revenant ork requires 65 Agility.
*The [[Pillar (Revenant Caves)#Medium|shortcut]] west of the northern revenant ork and the shortcuts in the north-western area require 75 Agility.
*The [[Pillar (Revenant Caves)#Hard|shortcut]] between the northern revenant ork and eastern revenant pyrefiend requires 89 Agility.

===Revenants===
{{Main|Revenants}}
[[Revenants]] are monsters that were slain during the [[God Wars]]. Extremely vengeful spirits, they are the main attraction of the dungeon. Revenants use all three forms of combat. They prioritise the [[combat style]] that the player is weak against as their primary attacks, and will adapt to any changes in equipment or prayers the player applies. They are also capable of healing themselves when their health falls below 50%.

Revenants drop various resources, equipment and several unique items. Revenants always drop [[revenant ether]], which is used to charge the [[bracelet of ethereum]]. This bracelet reduces all damage inflicted through a revenant's attack by 75%, at the cost of 1 charge per attack. It is carried at the player's own risk, as it is always lost on death with all charges regardless of the player's item protection settings. They also drop [[ancient artefacts]] that can be sold to the [[Emblem Trader]] wandering the caves for a hefty amount of coins. Revenants also drop [[ancient crystal]]s, four of which are required to build an [[Obelisk (Construction)|obelisk]] in the [[superior garden]] of a [[player-owned house]]. Lastly, they are able to drop weapons that are most effective if used within the Wilderness: [[Craw's bow]], [[Thammaron's sceptre]] and [[Viggora's chainmace]].

Killing revenants may also cause a [[revenant maledictus]] to spawn in one of several locations in the caves.

==Trivia==
*The caves are based on the {{RSL|Forinthry Dungeon}} in ''RuneScape 3''. Revenants were originally the replacement for [[player killers]] between December 2007 and February 2011 when PvP was removed from the Wilderness, and when it was reinstated, the dungeon was created to house the revenants.
